exact_statement: For every integer m>=1, on a finite uniform cube with disjoint c,u, m-bit Z and three-bit Y, let q2=-1 exactly on c=0,Z=0 and let G have ordered Boolean cores (Maj3,y0,-y0,-Maj3) indexed by c+2u. Start with common frequency reference R=(8/13,2/13,1/26,1/26,1/26,1/26,1/26,1/26). Use the stage5 five-cell control law with weights (1/4,1/4,1/16,7/20,7/80), uniform inside each cell, and the actual control-occupancy prior. Through every physical core query carry R by frequency marginalization to the SAME reference for both children and all four cores. For every core-only adaptive restriction history with no repeated coordinate on a path, complete each path to three core queries. Every node has signed excess e=max(0,Delta C_Q-4 Inf_i)<=1/4. Every complete actual terminal has 4I-C_Q>1 and remains nonconstant. Allocate each node excess to its final descendants with their physical conditional probabilities: the cumulative debit on any final terminal is <=3/4 from its ONE inherited complete terminal surplus, leaving >1/4. The exact signed telescope therefore proves H(F)<=C_Q(F)<4I(F)-1/4 for F=q2G, all m. At m=1, after Y1=0, the relevant query Y2 has 1/100<Delta C_Q-4 Inf_Y2<1/40, and both actual child core pairs are nonconstant. No arbitrary-core, control-query, depth-independent or universal FEI assertion is made.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean cube; entropy and reference cross entropy in bits.
Exactly the paired majority/literal cores and positive normalized core reference specified.
m>=1, event c=0,Z=0; fixed cell weights and actual flag prior retained.
Only physical Y queries, distinct along each branch; all actual terminal costs retained.
All negative query prices allocated cumulatively against one original complete terminal reserve; no reset.
